title: AccountRemovedPayload

accountId.description: An account's id on its environment: a version 4 UUID the environment mints when it adopts or adds the account; an account carried over from configuration keeps the id it was configured with.

reason.description: Why an account was removed: user (accounts.remove), or duplicate-identity (its sign-in yielded an identity another account on the environment holds, so the account and its new directory went).

description: account.removed: the environment no longer holds the account; its directory stays unless account.directory-deleted follows.
